prompts.background:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original wide game UI background painting, landscape 3:2. For Color Resonance, a Japanese fantasy RPG about restoring colors with a heart sword and four elemental spirits.
Primary request: a beautiful tranquil celestial grove at night, a luminous silver-white tree with graceful curved roots, a small glowing pearl at its heart, restrained teal, sage green, pale gold and lavender light flowing into its branches. Foreground pool reflecting the roots, distant archlike trees at edges, deep indigo sky with a few large clear stars. Hand-painted clean fantasy illustration, soft storybook watercolor lighting, smooth restrained textures and fine elegant botanical silhouettes.
Composition: tree occupies the left 60% and its canopy reaches the top; the right 40% is dark uncluttered atmospheric negative space where readable skill details will be placed. Central tree branches are spaced for UI constellation nodes; no embedded nodes or UI. Wide view with room around the canopy and roots. Beautiful delicate curves, calm broad gradients. No characters, no animals, no faces, no weapons, no text, no logos, no borders, no watermark, no tiny noisy particles or repeated patterned bark. Keep the image predominantly deep navy so white text remains readable.
髪は全て透過せず、下位レイヤーを描写しない
髪の不透明度は100％とする

intricate textures（複雑な質感）の要素は抑えめにし、過剰な微細描写、エッジノイズ、粒状のきらめき、鱗状の模様、等間隔に繰り返す細かな波打ちを避け、全体になめらかで清潔感のある質感を強調してください。
prompts.bloom:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original game magical strengthening VFX animation sprite sheet; 3 columns × 2 rows, six EXACTLY EQUAL square cells, row-major order, true transparent background.
Primary request: six consecutive cel frames of a refined luminous flower-star blooming from a pearl, for an enchanted tree skill-upgrade UI. One centered pearl surrounded by thin pale-gold arcs and smooth translucent-looking teal petal rays, with a subtle lavender outer halo. Frame 1: pearl and two short curved rays. Frame 2: four rays opening outward. Frame 3: six graceful petals open wider. Frame 4: full six-petal star bloom with small golden ring. Frame 5: petals soften and ring expands, pearl steady. Frame 6: petals fade smaller toward frame 1. Elegantly hand-painted magical VFX, clean smooth shapes, soft limited glow, few broad highlights. Dark UI will show behind real transparent alpha. Same central anchor and same size/scale in every cell, leave 15% blank margins, every shape completely inside own cell. No characters, no hair, no grid lines, no checkerboard, no numbers, no text, no black or white plate. Avoid noisy sparks, explosions, detailed fractals, dense particles. The sprite grid must remain geometrically exact.
